# Gift Stash / 선물 서랍

> Local-first gift-idea stash: capture screenshots, tag them to a person, get reminded before their birthday.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://gift-stash.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (IndexedDB for photos, localStorage for people/ideas). No accounts, no server-side storage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gift-stash.try-dabble.com/): People, ideas (file/paste), upcoming birthdays, search, export/import
- [Privacy](https://gift-stash.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://gift-stash.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/gift-stash): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add people with birthday (MM-DD or full date), notes, optional face photo
- Custom occasion dates (anniversary etc.)
- Capture gift ideas from file picker, camera, or Ctrl+V paste
- Tag ideas to a person or leave unassigned
- Idea status: idea / bought / given
- Upcoming strip: next 60 days of birthdays and occasions
- Optional on-device Notification API reminder (checked on load)
- Search across people and idea titles/notes
- JSON export/import (photos as data URLs, or skip photos)
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with network-first service worker
